audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 11 design-detail identification using the reusable image A to image D gallery.
audio_prompts.script: Look at image A to image D. Number one: This detail is a zipper. It is on the front of the jacket. It is functional because it opens and closes the garment. Number two: This detail is floral embroidery. It is near the neckline. It is decorative because it adds color and texture. Number three: These details are two patch pockets. They are on the front of the skirt. They are functional because they can hold small objects. Number four: This detail is a soft ruffle. It is at the hem. It is decorative because it makes the garment look playful.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each number and slight emphasis on the detail words and image keys.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
